title: Peak factor for Contributory Population
markdown:
| Contributory Population | Peak Factor |
| --- | --- |
| up to 20,000 | 3.00 |
| Above 20,001 to 50,000 | 2.50 |
| Above 50,001 to 7,50,000 | 2.25 |
| above 7,50,001 | 2.00 |
